criteria_results.evidence: DoorPrototypeSceneBuilder.BuildCamera() sets camera.orthographic = true and camera.orthographicSize = IsometricOrthographicSize (8f) at Assets/NoSafeCircle/DoorPrototype/Editor/DoorPrototypeSceneBuilder.cs:132-133. Nothing in IsometricCameraFollow.cs (the only other camera-touching script) ever sets orthographic back to false.

cameraObject.transform.rotation = Quaternion.Euler(IsometricCameraEulerAngles) with IsometricCameraEulerAngles = (30,-45,0) is set once in BuildCamera() (DoorPrototypeSceneBuilder.cs:22,135) and is never modified afterward — IsometricCameraFollow.LateUpdate() (IsometricCameraFollow.cs:25-30) only writes transform.position, never transform.rotation. Grepped every script under Assets/NoSafeCircle/DoorPrototype/Scripts for Camera/camera references — only IsometricCameraFollow.cs matches, and it exclusively writes transform.position in LateUpdate, never rotation (IsometricCameraFollow.cs:25-30). A further grep for Rotate/Orbit/input-driven rotation patterns across the same Scripts folder returned no matches. PlayerMovement.cs and the debug control scripts do not reference the camera at all.
